capabilities: Explains selected words in a side panel
Saves and exports a vocabulary library
Renders a mermaid word map of related words
Speaks pronunciations via TTS or system voice
extras: Desktop only; requires Obsidian 1.15.0+. Selected text is sent to the configured AI endpoint; AnkiConnect and Ollama requests stay local. Exports are written to a 'LexiSide Exports' folder in the vault root.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dictionary, so looking up a word's meanings, usage, nuance, and related words means leaving the note or switching apps.

relations.evidence: Uses the Pele mermaid renderer when it is available and falls back to Obsidian's built-in renderer.
push saved words to Anki through AnkiConnect

requires.name: DeepSeek (default provider, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint)

summary: Side-panel vocabulary explorer that explains selected English words with AI, showing structured meanings, usage, nuance, word family, and a mermaid word map.
